name: EEB 2256W
title: Current Topics in Evolutionary Medicine and Disease Ecology
description: Engagement with primary research literature in evolutionary medicine and disease ecology, and development of written communication skills through writing, editing, revising, and peer feedback.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011. Three credits of coursework in BIOL, EEB, MCB, or PNB.
